Prepare spline basis for back-calculation model

Source: R/run_backcalc.R
model_type_prep.Rd

This function prepares the spline basis and augments the stan_data list with the design matrices for the back-calculation model.

Usage

model_type_prep(
  stan_data,
  migration = NULL,
  rita = NULL,
  age = NULL,
  inf_model = 1,
  diag_model = 1,
  model_seed = NULL,
  basis = "ts",
  knots = 10,
  penalty = 2
)

Arguments

stan_data

A list of data formatted for Stan.

migration

Logical indicating whether to include migration in the model.

rita

Logical indicating whether to include RITA data in the model.

age

Logical indicating whether to include age-specific data in the model.

inf_model

Infection model type (1 = spline, 2 = random walk, 3 = GP).

diag_model

Diagnosis model type (1 = spline, 2 = random walk).

model_seed

Seed for model fitting.

basis

Basis type for the spline (default is "ts" for thin plate regression spline).

knots

Number of knots for the spline (default is 10).

penalty

Order of the penalty for the spline (default is 2).

Value

The augmented stan_data list with spline design matrices and prior information.
